sources.title: Territorial units and house numbers by the municipalities, Slovenia, 2004H2–2018H2
sources.publisher_and_attribution: Statistical Office of the Republic of Slovenia (SURS) and Surveying and Mapping Authority (SMA); cite SURS as required by SURS terms
sources.source_role: Municipality code/label dimension and dated municipality-area observations; supports per-code series presence, not historical name effective dates
sources.retrieval_query: Exact POST body retained at source/sistat-request.json; selected all municipality codes, 2017H1 and 2017H2, Area [sq. km]
sources.dataset_vintage: 2017H1=2017-01-01 and 2017H2=2017-07-01 observations; table reports 2004H2–2018H2 and page last-update 2022-01-24; municipality labels are one static dimension
sources.license: SURS statistical data and information are available for free unrestricted use with attribution to Statistical Office of the Republic of Slovenia/SURS; user modifications must be identified. The SURS notice says third-party rights are not altered.
sources.limit: A static current table dimension cannot establish what each official RPE name was in 2017; area observations do not establish polygon equivalence or source-name correctness.

sources.publisher: SURS; article reports Register of Spatial Units maintained by GURS
sources.role: Dated corroboration of 212 municipalities and register-maintainer context only
sources.limit: Article gives national totals and selected area extremes, not municipality names by code.

sources.title: Zakon o katastru nepremičnin (ZKN), Article 130
sources.role: Primary legal access rule for historical RPE data and the separate collection-of-documents route.
sources.finding: Article 130(2) grants everyone the right, subject to Articles 126–128, to view/copy historical RPE data; paragraph 4 says the historical data have been available in IS Kataster since 2022-04-04. Paragraph 3 separately authorizes geodetic professionals/state bodies to request access to collection-of-documents materials and historic copies. The earlier contrary interpretation is withdrawn.
sources.retention: restoration-only; official legal text cited, not redistributed
sources.limit: The statute is interpreted here only for access to historical RPE data; this packet makes no legal determination about collection-of-documents requests.

sources.publisher: Government of Slovenia describing the GURS Register of Spatial Units
sources.role: Identifies authoritative RPE fields (type, code, name, area) and states its documentary collection is retained permanently, physically and electronically
sources.limit: Describes GURS registry records and archival retention; direct historical name values are established by the retained official OBCINE_H response.

sources.publisher: Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS)
sources.role: Official historical RPE municipality name and validity features for all 53 exact candidate municipality codes; basis for names effective on 2017-01-01 and 2017-07-01.
sources.vintage: Municipality history collection; public historical service announced 2024-01-11; queried 2026-10-05 for exact 53-code set; full history available for municipalities per GURS notice.

license.terms: GURS public geodetic data are public information offered under CC BY 4.0 attribution subject to GURS general terms. Attribute Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS); identify the derived assessment.

sources.method: WFS 2.0 GetFeature against SI.GURS.RPE:OBCINE_H; CQL filter on the 53 leading-zero-preserved municipality codes (numeric in WFS); request attribute fields EID_OBCINA,SIFRA,NAZIV,NAZIV_DJ,DATUM_OD,DATUM_DO,DATUM_SYS,STATUS_VELJAVNOSTI; no geometry returned. For each code and target date, select the unique feature whose validity start is on/before the date and whose end is after it.
sources.limit: This evidence resolves names and validity only. Geometry is omitted and no boundary, parent, neighbor-granularity, or regional approval is inferred.
